subject: Film & Cinema
title: New Hollywood: Directors Take Power
description: A fast breakdown of New Hollywood: Directors Take Power for builders.

hook.text: By 1967, old Hollywood's safe formulas were bombing. Studios were desperate.

buildup.text: Young directors influenced by European art cinema got unprecedented creative freedom.

discovery.text: Bonnie and Clyde, Easy Rider, and The Graduate shattered audience expectations.

twist.text: Coppola's Apocalypse Now nearly destroyed him. Creative freedom has a cost.

climax.text: Jaws and Star Wars then proved spectacle sells — and studios reclaimed control.

punchline.text: The revolution lasted a decade. The blockbuster lasted forever.

quiz.question: What ended New Hollywood's director-driven era?
options: The commercial success of blockbusters like Jaws and Star Wars
